budget_items.what_was_recorded: The article is a vote to transfer 232,800 dollars from the FY23 capital plan to install ductless split climate control systems at the Lunenburg primary school; the superintendent said if prices rose they would include as many rooms as possible and push the rest to phase 3.
budget_items.quote: a vote to transfer 232,800 dollars from the fiscal year 23 capital plan to install ductless split climate control systems at the lunenburg primary school.
